scope: Historical pre-decision source inventory; approval/ADR/current profiles live in versioned documents, not this source commit.
retention: Keep source commit reachable; prefer PR13 merge commit preserving ancestry if repository policy allows; keep source feature branch. No release tag.
protected_tree_policy: Historical audit anchors only. Future gameplay/content progress is allowed; a G13 art-only reopening compares current-before/current-after, never restores these old trees over newer work.
exclusions: This manifest and newly written approval/ADR/closure documents (avoid self-hash loops)
limitations: Inventory and hash verification are not a restore drill, runtime hot-swap or save compatibility test.
source_commit_only rows may differ in the current tree due to deliberate documentation banners; use the recorded Git blob for historical content.
Future art candidates receive their own profile/inventory and do not overwrite v1.
